record.question: An uncertain number of persons are sitting in a straight line facing north. Three persons sit between P and Q. R sits second to the right of P. Only three people sit between Q and S. T is immediate to the left of P. R sits fifth from the right extreme ends of the row. X sits on the extreme end of the row. As many people sit between R and U as many between U and S. Y sits second to the left of V, who is an immediate neighbour of Q. Not more than two persons sit between V and S. Five people sit between S and X. As many people sit between S and W as many between W and X. Who among the following person sits sixth to the right of Q?
record.explanation: Solving the spacing constraints gives a 21-person row: X1,W4,S7,Y8,V10,Q11,U12,T14,P15,R17. The sixth place right of Q11 is R17. All named positions satisfy the given gaps and midpoint conditions. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
